repos_data.description: Validate Nigerian postcodes in Rust, Python, JavaScript, Java, PostgreSQL, DuckDB, and Polars, with MCP servers for AI agents. Covers Nigeria's NIPOST digital postcode (NDAPS): offline validation, lookup, and reverse geocoding.
Offline geocoder: a country in a file. Forward and reverse geocoding with Python, CLI, DuckDB and an MCP server for AI agents. No server, no API key.
MCP server for AtlasFetch: reverse geocode coordinates to country, region and municipality (ISO 3166), and match your own geofences.
